The '''Mandalorian Road''' was an ancient route from the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that connected [[Corsin/Legends|Corsin]] to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. In [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]], the Mandalorian Road was integral in piecing together the future [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].
